The '''attack on the ''[[Kuari Princess/Legends|Kuari Princess]]''''' occurred during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] while the luxury [[Starship/Legends|liner]] was traversing [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|the Maelstrom]], a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Albarrio sector/Legends|Albarrio]] and [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. The liner was attacked by the [[Riders of the Maelstrom]] that lived within the nebula.
